This document outlines the maintenance procedures on the generator

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mokhtar Gomaa Qarni, field-tested by
Eng. Yasser Abdel Rahman at El Kureimat 2 Power Station, accepted by
Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud, General Manager of Electrical Maintenance, approved by Eng. Fathy El Sayed Ibrahim, Head of El Kureimat 2 Power Station Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab:
Head of Technical Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company
and Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator.

rows: Issue a work order for the maintenance team, stating the occupational safety and health category of each individual
Provide a safety fence with caution marks around the work area at site

Wear the appropriate occupational safety and health equipment necessary for personal safety (safety shoes,
safety helmet,
coveralls,
gloves)

Note: The generator remains
in service
Soft cloth pieces for cleaning
Carbon brushes for replacement
Service air
Complete wrench set (5 mm Allen key - ordinary screwdriver)
Brush length gauge

sections_target.text: Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the earthing system and replacing them if necessary

rows: Wear tested insulating gloves
Visually inspect to determine the brush length against the marked replacement limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate brush pressure
Refit the brushes in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation

sections_target.text: Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the excitation system and replacing them if necessary

rows: Wear tested insulating gloves

Measure the brush with the brush length gauge
and check visually whether it has reached
the marked replacement limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate brush pressure
Refit the brushes in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation
When replacing brushes, change them one at a time; never change two brushes at the same time
Ensure that no tools or any other items are left inside the generator brush housing
Clean the air filter after removing it with wrenches
Clean the air dryer filter
Clean the excitation and earthing brush holders
Clean the generator body from the outside
Clean the excitation system room inside and out
Inspect the brush holder springs by pressing them and observing the spring-back action

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures on the generator
I1, which must be performed
monthly م1
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mokhtar Gomaa Qarni, field-tested by
Eng. Yasser Abdel Rahman at El Kureimat 2 Power Station, accepted by
Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud, General Manager of Electrical Maintenance, approved by Eng. Fathy El Sayed Ibrahim, Head of El Kureimat 2 Power Station Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab:
Head of Technical Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company
and Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work order for the maintenance team, stating the occupational safety and health category of each individual | 
Provide a safety fence with caution marks around the work area at site | 
Wear the appropriate occupational safety and health equipment necessary for personal safety (safety shoes,
safety helmet,
coveralls,
gloves) | 
Note: The generator remains
in service | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Soft cloth pieces for cleaning | 
Carbon brushes for replacement | 
Service air | 
Complete wrench set (5 mm Allen key - ordinary screwdriver)
Brush length gauge
Work to be Carried Out
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the earthing system and replacing them if necessary
Wear tested insulating gloves | 1.
Visually inspect to determine the brush length against the marked replacement limit | 2.
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate brush pressure | 3.
Refit the brushes in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation | 4.
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the excitation system and replacing them if necessary
Wear tested insulating gloves | 1.
Measure the brush with the brush length gauge
and check visually whether it has reached
the marked replacement limit | 2.
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate brush pressure | 3.
Refit the brushes in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation | 4.
Note:
When replacing brushes, change them one at a time; never change two brushes at the same time | 1.
Ensure that no tools or any other items are left inside the generator brush housing | 2.
Remaining Procedures
Clean the air filter after removing it with wrenches | 1.
Clean the air dryer filter | 2.
Clean the excitation and earthing brush holders | 3.
Clean the generator body from the outside | 4.
Clean the excitation system room inside and out | 5.
Inspect the brush holder springs by pressing them and observing the spring-back action | 6.
